A '''planet''' in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]] was the location of [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and its surrounding fleet. The planet orbited a [[Star/Legends|yellow star]] and had one visible [[Unidentified moon (Vaiken Spacedock)|moon]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
